same_input_core_controls.scope: Recorded first-layer same inputs and AX incoming state; original CPU functions at recorded BF16 boundaries. Not an independent full graph or QMM test.
same_input_core_controls.tolerance_source: Existing fixed F32 2e-5 and BF16 1e-3 operator tolerances.

isolated_prefix_factorial.scope: Original first-layer prefix; factorial decay and recurrence-schedule intervention with fixed original inputs/projections. Not a production change or full-model acceptance.

complete_distribution_comparison.scope: Descriptive pairwise differences on identical saved full-vocabulary logits; no threshold selection or quality inference.

limitations: One fixed four-token prefix and four singleton inputs; findings do not generalize to other prompts, lengths or loaded initial states.
Changing only the original official prefill schedule changes full logits by up to2.203125 and changes one greedy token; AX versus recurrent reference remains different up to2.09375.
The original chunk reference has exactly tied maxima271/561 at the differing decode step; this contextualizes greedy mismatch without changing any tie policy.
Decay substitution changes no isolated final GDN output bits on this prefix; no claim that every intermediate or every other request is unaffected.
The diagnostic alternate schedule does not replace the original oracle or establish that either schedule is universally more accurate.
Layer-output errors and full-logit errors are different surfaces; their magnitudes cannot identify the dominant full-model error source.
Routing and cache are independently carried by the official graph; downstream states are expected to change after the schedule intervention.
Jensen-Shannon distances and top-two margins describe recorded logits only; no acceptance threshold or broader quality score is inferred.
Quantized projections share MLX. Header/stat identities do not hash entire checkpoint payloads. Timings include observations and transfers and are not performance evidence.
Full-model numerical/quality work, trained-MTP contract validation and profitability remain open; unavailable M5 Ultra is not qualified.
